criterion_descriptions: Evaluate whether the agent restricted browsing to the official Daft Punk MusicBrainz artist record and used only the 'Album' section under 'official release groups'. Full credit if the agent attempts to navigate this exact scope but cannot access it due to external issues (site down, CAPTCHA, blocked content, layout change) and clearly reports the limitation. Partial credit if the agent briefly consults other sections before returning to the correct Album section, while not using excluded combined sections as the basis for selection. No credit if the agent primarily uses non-official release groups or excluded combined sections (Album+Compilation/Live/Soundtrack/Remix/etc.) to select entries when the correct Album section is available.

Within the Album section under official release groups, select the first three entries that have dates displayed, in the on-page chronological order, skipping undated entries, and stop once three are identified. Full credit if the agent does this correctly OR if the agent explains that the displayed ordering/dates cannot be reliably determined due to external factors (e.g., the page fails to load dates, sorting UI differs, or the Album section is unavailable) after a reasonable attempt. Partial credit if three dated albums are selected but there is a minor ordering mistake while still plausibly within the first-three set given the displayed list. No credit if the agent includes undated entries as qualifying, pulls from a different section, or disregards the displayed order when it is accessible.

For the first qualifying dated Album entry, the agent should open the release-group page and report the release-group title and the 'First release date' field from that release-group page (not an individual release date). Full credit if title is correct and the date matches exactly what the release-group page shows, even if MusicBrainz provides only a partial date (YYYY or YYYY-MM). Full credit if the agent cannot open the release-group page due to external access issues but clearly reports the failure after attempting. Partial credit if the correct title is given but the date is taken from an individual release (not the release-group field) or is incomplete relative to what is shown on the release-group page. No credit if the wrong release group is used or information is fabricated.

For the second qualifying dated Album entry, the agent should open the release-group page and report the release-group title and the 'First release date' field from that release-group page (not an individual release date). Full credit if title is correct and the date matches exactly what the release-group page shows, even if MusicBrainz provides only a partial date (YYYY or YYYY-MM). Full credit if the agent cannot open the release-group page due to external access issues but clearly reports the failure after attempting. Partial credit if the correct title is given but the date is taken from an individual release (not the release-group field) or is incomplete relative to what is shown on the release-group page. No credit if the wrong release group is used or information is fabricated.

For the third qualifying dated Album entry, the agent should open the release-group page and report the release-group title and the 'First release date' field from that release-group page (not an individual release date). Full credit if title is correct and the date matches exactly what the release-group page shows, even if MusicBrainz provides only a partial date (YYYY or YYYY-MM). Full credit if the agent cannot open the release-group page due to external access issues but clearly reports the failure after attempting. Partial credit if the correct title is given but the date is taken from an individual release (not the release-group field) or is incomplete relative to what is shown on the release-group page. No credit if the wrong release group is used or information is fabricated.

Evaluate whether the agent stops after exactly three qualifying Album entries are recorded and does not include excluded combined sections (Album+Compilation/Live/Soundtrack/Remix/etc.) among the three. Full credit if the agent outputs exactly three items and none are from excluded combined sections; also award full credit if the agent is prevented from completing due to external access/data issues and clearly states it stopped early for that reason without adding extra non-qualifying items. Partial credit if the agent finds the correct first three but also lists additional entries. No credit if the agent includes excluded-section items as part of the three when the correct Album section is available.
